scope: Changed/new LDRs plus exactly deferred11; unbuilt courses are not unknown-part records
method: Reuse current course JSON ledgers/reviews + current LDR unresolved comments and actual approximation placements. Group confirmed aliases using prior research. Generic interfaces kept separate from missing part IDs.
limits: Raw observations may contain historical identities; registry overrides stale6669/6528 claims.4663/14094/2296p01 now available; do not count these as absent geometry merely from old prose.
Source page null means not recorded, not page1. LDR step is preserved separately and never automatically treated as PDF page.
Mast6521 vs6522 uncertain; inventory color is not length proof.
Deferred11 source pixels were not newly reviewed; no inferred IDs added.

Source-shape supplements preserve latest author requests; later course ledgers may resolve these and take precedence. Markdown observations may include older claims, retained as raw evidence rather than completion status.
partIssues is the curated current issue-family list. Raw groups preserve old observations but are not an unknown-ID count. Known connection omissions do not imply absent geometry.
